name: Arsenal Mastery
author: AsobiCodes / Moritz Wallinger
description: OpenRAC Arsenal Mastery port with persistent per-save weapon XP, V1-V5 power progression, Enhanced RAC HUD, stable hit-watcher attribution and enemy rebalance.

settings.name: XP rate
settings.description: Multiplier for weapon XP earned from enemy damage.

settings.name: Level power
settings.description: Apply Arsenal Mastery's V1-V5 weapon power multipliers.

settings.name: Enemy rebalance
settings.description: Apply Arsenal Mastery's planet-based enemy durability curve.

settings.name: Hard rebalance
settings.description: Multiply the enemy durability curve by the original Hard factor.

settings.name: Weapon damage
settings.description: Additional multiplier applied after weapon level power.

settings.name: Trace
settings.description: Log attributed hits, XP gains, levels and damage scaling for testing.

settings.name: Weapon XP HUD
settings.description: Show the equipped weapon's V1-V5 level and persistent XP progress in the Enhanced RAC Style.

settings.name: Level-up notice
settings.description: Show an Enhanced RAC Style banner when a weapon reaches the next Arsenal Mastery level.
